skills.name: Basic Attack
skills.description: Standard basic attack.

skills.name: Gilded Sun-Aegis
skills.description: Grants a massive shield equal to 30% of Chanterelle's Max HP to all allies. For 2 turns, all damage dealt by shielded allies restores a portion of their shields. (30% of Chanterelle's Max HP is the cap).

skills.name: Azure Rain of Ruin
skills.description: Fires 10 piercing arrows at random enemies at 33% power with a 100% chance to Bleed for each arrow. Deals 50% bonus damage to targets already bleeding. (Bonus damage doesn't stack)

skills.name: Roar of the Enlightened
skills.description: Deals heavy AoE damage with a 100% chance to Silence for 1 turn. Enters a "Zen Trance" for 2 turns, countering EVERY attack received with a Silence-inducing strike.

skills.name: Hallucinogenic Hysteria
skills.description: Deals massive AoE damage to all enemies that scales with all Ibotenic Acid stacks in play. Guaranteed to Confuse all enemies for 2 turns; Confused enemies take 100% more DoT damage.

skills.name: Shatterproof Glaze
skills.description: Taunts all enemies for 2 turns, increasing Self DEF by 150%. Redirects 50% of all team damage to self, reducing the redirected damage by 75%.

skills.name: Purifying Spore Cloud
skills.description: Cleanses 1 debuff from all allies, restores all allies HP based on self POT stat, and grants ally Tanks regen for 3 turns.

skills.name: Amber Assimilation
skills.description: Roots all enemies for 1 turn and heals lowest health ally based on own POT. Doubles all Synergy stat bonuses for the remainder of the battle.

skills.name: Phantom Strike
skills.description: Enters Stealth for 3 turns. Unleashes a devastating strike on the lowest HP enemy with a 300% Crit Damage modifier. If this kills, immediately cast it again.

skills.name: Kaleidoscope Copycat
skills.description: Lowers all enemy DEF by 10%. Instantly mimics the last Ultimate used by any ally or enemy at 150% effectiveness, bypassing all energy requirements.

skills.name: Wrath of the Mushroom King
skills.description: Boosts team POT by 50% then commands all allies use their Signature Skills on a single target without consuming cooldowns or energy.

skills.name: Song of the Drowning Veil
skills.description: Plunges the entire enemy team into a deep Sleep for 1 turn. Upon waking, they are Confused for 1 turn. Siren remains in unbroken Stealth for 2 turns.

skills.name: Swamp's Inescapable Grasp
skills.description: Pulls all backline enemies to the front row (If front row is full pulls them to the middle row). Then stunning the entire team for 1 turn and dealing massive AoE damage. Grants self Stealth and 100% bonus damage to front row targets.

skills.name: Seismic Quake
skills.description: Does a massive AoE quake that strikes 4 times choosing an enemy randomly. Each strike has a 50% chance to apply Poison. The entire attack repeats at 100% effectiveness.

skills.name: Ancestral Ritual
skills.description: Restores 100% Energy to the ally with the lowest Energy and grants the entire team a shield equal to 50% of the Shaman's Max HP.

skills.name: Abyssal Maw
skills.description: Heals the lowest HP ally to full. Empowers the entire team's next action by +150% effectiveness.

skills.name: Toxic Banquet
skills.description: Applies 3 stacks of Poison to all enemies. For the next 2 turns, all allies gain 50% Lifesteal against Poisoned targets.

skills.name: Fermented Depth Charge
skills.description: Detonates all DoT effects on the enemy team instantly, dealing 300% of their remaining damage at once, and reapplying 1 stack of Poison to survivors.

skills.name: Labyrinth of the Quagmire
skills.description: Places a Trap on every enemy grid. Forces all enemies to move randomly, guaranteeing trap detonations that deal immense damage and permanently Root them.

skills.name: Exorcist's Final Flame
skills.description: Deals devastating single-target damage, multiplied by 3.0x if the target has any status effects. Guaranteed critical hit with +50% Crit Damage.

skills.name: Catastrophic Shipwreck
skills.description: Reduces enemy ATK by 50%. Places a mushroom bomb on every empty tile; bombs instantly detonate if an enemy is knocked into them.

skills.name: Shattered Marrow Execution
skills.description: Deals heavy single-target damage, reducing the target's ATK and DEF by 50% for 3 turns and grants them the taunt buff for 3 turns. If the target dies, the debuff spreads to all remaining enemies.

skills.name: Midnight Dissolution
skills.description: Targets the lowest HP enemy performing a basic attack at 150% power and executes them instantly if their below 40% HP. If successful, resets cooldown and repeats ultimate skill immediately.

skills.name: Grasp from the Grave
skills.description: Grants 100% Lifesteal for 3 turns then consumes 50% of current HP to deal devastating 500% damage to one target.

skills.name: Noxious Rot Cloud
skills.description: Reduces the enemy team ATK and POT by 40% for 3 turns, applies a burn stack.

skills.name: Inferno of the Harvest
skills.description: Ignites all enemies with a 100% Burn chance granting them a stack of burn. Gains +15% ATK for every Burn stack applied, then unleashes a massive AoE flare with 100% basic attack power.

skills.name: Crimson Spore Barrage
skills.description: Fires 12 random shots across the enemy team. Deals 4x damage to Shields and permanently shatters them upon impact.

skills.name: Chromatic Death Wind
skills.description: Reduces enemy SPD by 50% for 3 turns. Deals massive AoE damage do all enemies, increased in power by 20% times the number of debuffs on each enemy.

skills.name: Screech of the Damned Urn
skills.description: Removes all enemies of Stealth and 1 additional buff (if present). Increases team SPD by 30% for 2 turns and heals allies based Devil Urn's POT at 20% times the number of buffs removed.

skills.name: Symphony of the Blood Feast
skills.description: Boosts team Crit Chance to 100% for 1 turn. Deals massive AoE damage, healing the entire team for 100% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Soot-Cloud Assassination
skills.description: Enters Stealth for 2 turns. The next three attacks are guaranteed Critical Hits with +150% Crit Damage, instantly returning to Stealth after each hit.

skills.name: Absolute Zero Volley
skills.description: Grants all allies 20% Defense Penetration. Fires a piercing shot that hits all Frozen enemies 5 times in rapid succession, instantly shattering them, removing the debuff for massive bonus damage.

skills.name: Avalanche Bulwark
skills.description: Grants a shield equal to 50% of Snow-Bank Hermit's max HP to the entire team and redirects ALL single-target damage to the Hermit for 2 turns, while reflecting 30% of it back.

skills.name: Glacial Evisceration
skills.description: Deals heavy damage with a 100% chance to Freeze the target for 3 turns. Deals 200% bonus damage if the target was already Frozen.

skills.name: Eternal Winter's Grasp
skills.description: Grants all allies a permanent immunity to Burn for 2 turns removing all burn stacks in the process. Drops a blizzard that completely halts the enemy team (reduces SPD by 50%) as long as the Sentinel remains shielded. Grants Sentinel a shield equal to 100% of it's max HP.

skills.name: Sub-Zero Suffocation
skills.description: Deals massive AoE damage, reducing enemy ATK and POT by 25%. Guaranteed to freeze all enemies for 1 turn.

skills.name: Supernova Sprint
skills.description: Converts 50% of the Scout's SPD into ATK for the team. Grants two allies an immediate extra turn with fully refreshed cooldowns.

skills.name: Shattering Frost-Grip
skills.description: Fully cleanses the team of all debuffs. Deals heavy damage to one enemy, applying a 100% Brittle debuff (takes double damage from next attack).

skills.name: Mirror of the Ice-Queen
skills.description: Taunts all enemies for 2 turns. Reflects 100% of all incoming damage back to the attackers while reducing their ATK by 10% per hit for 2 turns.

skills.name: Northern Lights Crescendo
skills.description: Bathes the team in cosmic light, healing all allies at 50% POT efficiency, doubling all incoming healing for 3 turns, and granting a 50% Crit Rate boost.

skills.name: Thawing Tsunami
skills.description: Cleanses all team debuffs and grants itself 10% SPD per debuff removed for 4 turns. All ally basic attacks has a 50% additional chance to Freeze for 2 turns.

skills.name: The Great Stalling
skills.description: Applies a volatile Burn to all enemies. While they remain Burns stack now tick twice per turn for 3 turns and reduce enemy healing received by 50%.

skills.name: Master Chef's Feast
skills.description: Taunts all enemies for 3 turns. Restores 100% Max HP and grants a 25% Max HP shield that regenerates every turn.

skills.name: Hyper-Fermentation
skills.description: Grants 60 Energy to ALL allies and immediately heals them for 30% of their Max HP.

skills.name: Thousand-Slice Julienne
skills.description: Targets the lowest DEF enemy. Unleashes 10 rapid strikes; each consecutive hit ignores 10% DEF and boosts the Cadet's SPD by 10%.

skills.name: Armor of the Umami Shogun
skills.description: Grants all allies a stack of the 3 "Taste" buffs (ATK, DEF, and SPD) for 2 turns. Basic attacks now have a 100% chance to inflict Burn.

skills.name: Cauldron's Golden Invincibility
skills.description: Grants all allies Intangible (untargetable/invulnerable) for 1 turn and applies a powerful Regen effect.

skills.name: Bountiful Forage
skills.description: Put 'Scraps', a type of buffing trap, on the ally teams side. If an ally is on a Scrap trap they consume it and get regen for 3 turns and increases their Crit Damage and Crit Rate by 30%.

skills.name: Needle-Storm Execution
skills.description: Fires a massive volley of 20 arrows at 20% efficiency that guarantees "Vulnerability" on all targets. Deals 50% bonus damage to enemies suffering from any debuffs.

skills.name: Impenetrable Plumage
skills.description: Redirects ALL single-target damage from the back row to itself for 2 turns using the Guard's massive DEF stat. Grants a stacking 20% DEF buff to the entire team.

skills.name: Crustacean Bisque Deluge
skills.description: Grants a massive 50% Max HP shield to the entire team and immediately applies an overwhelming Regen effect to the front row.

skills.name: Black Hole — Ultimate
skills.description: Ultimate for Nebula Cordyceps. A high-impact finisher that expands on Black Hole.
